from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowMetric(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash flow metric extracted from a company's financial report."""
    reporting_company: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company issuing the report")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial period covered, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item, e.g., '偿还债务支付的现金'")
    metric_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for the metric; 0 if dash")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_metrics: list[CashFlowMetric]
